extracted.intended_audience: MIT community members (faculty, students, staff, alumni) and members of the news media / journalists seeking press or media services
extracted.subtask_description: Description of the services, scope, and publishing channels of the MIT News Office — intended to inform campus constituents and journalists about what the office does, what it publishes, and how to contact it. Useful for people preparing announcements or seeking media assistance at MIT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote MIT’s research, innovations, teaching and newsworthy events and people
rubrics_metrics.description: Promote MIT’s research, innovations, teaching and newsworthy events and people to the campus community, the news media and the general public;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies press-materials should highlight research, innovations, teaching, events, and people in ways suitable for campus, media, and public audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate Institute announcements
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MIT News Office serves as a channel for official Institute announcements — materials intended as Institute-level announcements fall within their remit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish community news for faculty, students, staff and alumni
rubrics_metrics.description: Publish community news for MIT faculty, students, staff and alumni;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content targeted at internal constituencies (faculty, students, staff, alumni) is part of MIT News’ publication scope and likely formatted for those audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide media services and advice on working with journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide media services to members of the community, including advice on working with journalists;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The office offers guidance on interacting with reporters — submitters can expect coaching on interviews, messaging, and media protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to media inquiries and interview requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Respond to media inquiries and interview requests;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The office coordinates responses to journalists and manages interview scheduling/requests on behalf of Institute members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assist with film crew requests and permitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Assist with film crew requests, including handling all necessary permitting;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests involving on-campus filming should route through MIT News Office so they can arrange permissions and logistical support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handle public relations for major announcements, news conferences and symposia
rubrics_metrics.description: Handle public relations for major announcements, news conferences and symposia;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For large or high-profile events, the office manages PR strategy, media outreach, and event publicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a public information office in emergencies and crises
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a public information office in emergencies and crises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The office acts as the official information source during emergencies — crisis communications follow specialized procedures and messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish on the MIT homepage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected items may be featured on the Institute’s main web home — suitability and newsworthiness determine placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish on the MIT News website (articles, announcements, photos, video)
rubrics_metrics.description: MIT News website, featuring news articles, announcements, photos and video;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary channel for news-style content — submissions should be geared for news articles, announcements and multimedia presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribute via MIT Daily/Weekly newsletters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short-form items or timely announcements may be included in the daily/weekly email newsletters to the community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish on MIT YouTube channel
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Video-first content or recorded interviews/segments may be distributed via the Institute’s YouTube channel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide photographs and multimedia
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The office handles photo and multimedia assets for stories and can provide or coordinate photography/video for press materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and logistics information for media engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Address and contact information: MIT News Office, 77 Massachusetts Avenue, Room 11-400, Cambridge, MA 02139-4307; Email newsoffice@mit.edu; Phone: 617-253-2700; Fax: 617-258-8762
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use provided contact points to submit announcements, request media services, arrange interviews, or coordinate filming and permitting.
